notes: AUDIT ONLY - no files other than this results JSON were written; database, public snapshot, research corpus and code untouched. All fetches performed 2026-10-11. Key caveats: (1) All DFAT URLs for record 44 (Australia Awards MAP) timed out repeatedly; classification rests on the official Australian Embassy Thailand press release, so DFAT confirmation of a next round is still pending. (2) Record 598 (Banco de la República) is the only record whose single official URL was blocked by a Radware CAPTCHA on both attempts; it is classified 'uncertain' with low confidence and needs a manual check. (3) Record 288 (BME): the official BME scholarships page covers only outbound mobility and publishes no intake dates/amounts; the other URLs in the record's official_urls list belong to unrelated organisations (ANR, Chinese Embassy, SUTD, VUW, WUR) and were excluded as non-authoritative for BME. (4) logo_or_image_url is null for every record because no image asset was separately fetched and verified to render from the awarding body's own domain; logos seen in page markup (e.g. UCAS, ANU, SMU, BME, TWAS, Nokia Foundation) were deliberately not cited under this rule. (5) For record 314 (CAS-ANSO) the coverage/benefit amounts are published only as an image on the UCAS page, so funding_on_page is null rather than guessed. (6) Records 114, 245, 443, 646 and 688 show closed rounds with no published next date on the fetched official pages; several pages carry stale status wording ('call is closed' aside, SECIHTI still shows 'Abierta', Bolashak still says 'has started') which reviewers should treat with care. (7) Record 729 (Vanier CGS) is firmly discontinued per the official site and superseded by the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral program.
